summary: Russian forces have advanced near Golubivka and Stupochky according to Ukrainian monitoring sources, while simultaneously liberating Izhvka in DPR according to Russian state media. Russia's Ministry of Defense claims strikes on Ukrainian warehouses and military bases have halved fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces. Germany has launched serial production of over 5,000 kamikaze drones for Ukraine at a cost of €300 million.
key_points: Enemy advanced near Golubivka and Stupochky according to Ukrainian monitoring source DeepStateUA. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793)
Russia claims to have liberated Izhvka in DPR according to TASS agency report. (Source: @tass_agency/393643)
Russian strikes on warehouses and military bases have cut fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces by half according to Russian security sources. (Source: @tass_agency/393612)
Germany launched serial production of over 5,000 kamikaze drones for Ukraine costing €300 million, manufactured by Auterion-Airlogix joint venture. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32984)
SBU and GUR officers were involved in a shootout over Kaplunov's arrest; SBU published correspondence attributed to him. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32972)
Ukraine returned 13 citizens from occupation aged 27 to 87, including a couple from Kherson who have been under occupation since February 2022. (Source: @UkraineNow/83867)
Ukraine is implementing a warehouse decentralization program to protect businesses from systematic Russian attacks, with working groups formed with regional authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/83869)
Video released showing battles for Vasylevka, Blagovatnoye, and Dolzhanka in Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32975)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have advanced near Golubivka and Stupochky while simultaneously claiming to have liberated Izhvka in DPR. Russia's Ministry of Defense reports that strikes on Ukrainian warehouses and military bases have halved fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces, with Ukrainian military personnel already complaining of fuel shortages. Germany has launched serial production of over 5,000 kamikaze drones for Ukraine at a cost of €300 million through a joint venture between Auterion and Airlogix. Multiple waves of Shahed drones are currently targeting Kyiv and surrounding regions from various launch locations.

points: Ukraine has returned 13 citizens from Russian occupation, aged 27 to 87, including elderly and severely ill individuals, with some immediately hospitalized; a couple from Kherson who have been under occupation since February 2022 were among those returned, with the operation coordinated by state bodies, ICRC, humanitarian organizations, and medical personnel. (Source: @UkraineNow/83867)

Ukraine is implementing a warehouse decentralization program to protect businesses from systematic Russian attacks, with special working groups helping entrepreneurs relocate storage and operations to safer locations, coordinated with the Ministry of Community Development and regional military administrations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83869)

The Ukrainian President's Office reports that two participants in an armed incident in Kyiv – an SBU employee and a GUR military member – have been notified of suspicions related to weapons violations; investigations include the disappearance of a GUR RDK fighter with active searches for those involved and movement routes. (Source: @UkraineNow/83866)

Ukrainian businesses will receive government assistance to relocate warehouses to safer locations under a new program designed to protect enterprises from systematic Russian strikes, with operational groups handling logistics, communications, and alternative sites in other regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83869)

A Kyiv court is investigating a soldier who threatened a passerby with a captured assault rifle over 'foreign music,' according to police reports, indicating discipline issues within Ukrainian forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32962)

Russian strikes on Ukrainian warehouses and military bases have halved fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces, with Ukrainian military personnel already beginning to complain about fuel shortages according to Russian security sources cited by TASS. (Source: @tass_agency/393612)
Russian forces have liberated Izhvka in DPR according to the Russian Ministry of Defense, as reported by TASS news agency. (Source: @tass_agency/393643)

The Russian Foreign Ministry's Zakharova stated that Russia is ready for contacts on Ukraine but emphasized the implementation of possible agreements as the key issue, in an interview with Izvestia. (Source: @tass_agency/393632)

Russia's Embassy in Berlin stated that locations of planned long-range German weapons systems in case of deployment against Russia would become legitimate military targets, in an interview with Izvestia. (Source: @tass_agency/393630)

Russia's Foreign Ministry stated that Kyiv could carry out terrorist attacks against the West, with Zakharova questioning what guarantee Zelenskiy has that such attacks would not target his own citizens. (Source: @tass_agency/393631)
Russian Geran (Shahed) drones destroyed a locomotive repository belonging to Metinvest company, indicating continued targeting of industrial infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32966)
The enemy has advanced near Golubivka and Stupochky according to Ukrainian monitoring source DeepStateUA, which maintains the operational map of the conflict. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793)

Video footage has emerged showing battles for the villages of Vasylevka, Blagovatnoye, and Dolzhanka in Kharkiv region, whose liberation was previously reported through ukr_leaks_eng. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32975)

Enemy tactical aviation activity is being monitored on the southeastern direction, with threats of aviation strikes for front-line regions according to Ukrainian air defense monitoring sources. (Source: @kpszsu/76212)

Two new jet Shahed drones launched from Donetsk direction are heading towards Dnipropetrovshchyna according to monitoring data, indicating persistent drone activity from eastern positions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73633)
Two jet Shahed drones from Dnipropetrovshchyna are crossing towards Cherkashchyna region, demonstrating the continued pattern of drone attacks from eastern positions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73630)

Ukraine's Kyiv region and capital face multiple incoming Shahed threats from various directions – one jet Shahed approaching from Boryspil district towards Brovary, another passing Slavutych toward Kyiv region, with additional drones from Poltavshchyna crossing into Chernihivshchyna near Nizhyn heading south. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73631)

A jet UAV is heading toward Trostyanets in Sumy region from the northwest according to air defense monitoring, while a group of non-jet drones is approaching Lebedyn in Sumy from the north heading west. (Source: @kpszsu/76270)

Multiple jet Shahed drones are targeting Sumy region: one heading to Lypova Dolyna from northeast, one to Hadyach from northeast, and one to Mykolaivka from the north, indicating concentrated northern drone activity. (Source: @kpszsu/76263)

Five groups of non-jet drones are approaching Sumy region past Nyzy and Lebedyn on a western course, while two jet drones are targeting Dnipropetrovshchyna toward Hubynykha. (Source: @eRadarrua/110615)
A jet UAV is approaching Kyiv from north and south simultaneously according to air defense monitoring, creating a multi-directional threat to the capital. (Source: @kpszsu/76242)
A jet UAV is targeting Odeshchyna/Mykolaivshchyna from the sea, according to air defense monitoring, indicating naval-launched drone operations. (Source: @kpszsu/76250)
UAVs are approaching Kherson from the south and Zaporizhzhia from the east according to air defense monitoring, demonstrating continued southern threat vectors. (Source: @kpszsu/76244)
A jet UAV is on the western Mykolaivshchyna heading north according to monitoring data, suggesting reverse-direction targeting patterns. (Source: @kpszsu/76254)
A Geran-5 cruise missile-drone is targeting Kyiv/Irpin according to air defense monitoring, indicating long-range strike capabilities. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73611)

Russia is using jet Shahed drones launched from multiple locations including Vinnychchyna targeting Kyivshchyna, and from Donetsk targeting Dnipropetrovshchyna, with current concentration on Dnipropetrovshchyna, Mykolaivshchyna, and Chernihivshchyna for Kyiv breakthroughs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73629)

Air defense monitoring indicates mass launches of jet Shahed drones from all launch locations, with concentration currently on Dnipropetrovshchyna, Mykolaivshchyna, and Chernihivshchyna aimed at penetrating toward Kyiv and region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73627)

At least 10+ jet Shahed drones are currently in flight targeting Kyiv and surrounding areas from multiple launch vectors – from Dnipropetrovshchyna and Kharkivshchyna toward Poltavshchyna, from Vinnychchyna toward Kyivshchyna, from Donetsk toward Dnipropetrovshchyna. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73643)

The current air threat includes jet Shahed drones targeting multiple districts of Kyiv – one heading toward Podil/Pechersk, one toward DVBR, one toward Vynohradar, and one toward Vyshneve, indicating concentrated capital targeting. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73634)
Two jet Shahed drones are targeting Cherkasy according to monitoring data, with additional drones heading toward Kropyvnytskyi and Slavutych from various regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73645)
Enemy tactical aviation activity is noted on the southeastern direction with threats of aviation strikes for front-line regions, including KAB bombs targeting Sumy region. (Source: @kpszsu/76212)

key_developments: Russia claims its forces liberated Izhvka in DPR while Ukrainian sources confirm enemy advances near Golubivka and Stupochky, indicating ongoing contested fighting in eastern Ukraine. (Source: @tass_agency/393643, @DeepStateUA/23793)

Russian strikes on Ukrainian warehouses and military bases have cut fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces by half according to Russian security sources, with Ukrainian military personnel already complaining of shortages. (Source: @tass_agency/393612)

Germany has launched serial production of over 5,000 kamikaze drones for Ukraine at €300 million through Auterion-Airlogix joint venture, with first units rolling off assembly line near Munich. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32984)

A shootout occurred between SBU special forces and GUR officers over the arrest of Kaplunov, deputy commander of Russian Volunteer Corps, with SBU publishing allegedly incriminating correspondence. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32972)

Multiple waves of jet Shahed drones are currently targeting Kyiv from various launch vectors including Dnipropetrovshchyna, Kharkivshchyna, Vinnychchyna, and Donetsk, with concentrated strikes on capital districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73634, @mon1tor_ua/73639)

Ukraine returned 13 citizens from Russian occupation including vulnerable individuals aged 27-87, with a Kherson couple returning after two years of occupation since February 2022. (Source: @UkraineNow/83867)

Russia threatens that locations of German long-range weapons systems would become legitimate military targets if deployed against Russia, escalating NATO-Russia tensions. (Source: @tass_agency/393630)
sections.threat_assessment: The air threat to Ukraine remains severe with mass launches of jet Shahed drones from multiple directions targeting Kyiv and surrounding regions. Russian strikes on fuel infrastructure have significantly degraded Ukrainian military logistics capabilities, with reported halving of fuel supplies. Internal security tensions between SBU and GUR over the Kaplunov incident indicate potential coordination challenges within Ukrainian security services. The combination of external air attacks and internal security incidents creates a complex threat environment requiring enhanced defensive and coordination measures.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is responding to Russian strikes by implementing warehouse decentralization programs to protect critical business infrastructure from systematic attacks, with working groups coordinating relocation of storage facilities to safer regions. Germany continues military support through production of 5,000+ kamikaze drones at €300 million cost, with assembly near Munich and planned second site in eastern Germany. The international humanitarian response facilitated return of 13 citizens including vulnerable elderly and ill individuals from Russian-occupied territories through coordination with ICRC and humanitarian organizations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The SBU-GUR internal conflict over Kaplunov's arrest reveals potential intelligence coordination problems, with the FSB allegedly recruiting him to assassinate Russian opposition figures while he claims SBU coercion. Russian Foreign Ministry statements suggest potential escalation scenarios involving terrorist attacks on Western targets allegedly linked to Ukrainian operations. Slovak PM Fico's comments indicate European fatigue with Ukraine's financial requests despite the €90 billion EU loan approval, suggesting potential diplomatic pressures. Trump's reported comments about meeting Putin when parties are ready for peace agreements indicate potential diplomatic developments that could affect conflict trajectory.
